name: Chinese Soviet Republic (1931–1937)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the emblem of the Chinese Soviet Republic: a globe bearing a hammer and sickle within wheat ears beneath a star, with the republic's name in Chinese above.
history: Flag of the Chinese Soviet Republic (1931–1937), the communist state in Jiangxi.

features.role: emblem with globe, hammer and sickle, wheat and star
